problem: Essential self-adjointness of chi(xi) + chi'(eta) for the Bullough-Dodd S-matrix

nodes.S: Known for every n: chi_n(xi) = n P_n A_1^2 P_n and chi'_n(eta) = n P_n B_n^2 P_n are each positive self-adjoint on H_n intersected with Dom(A_1^2), resp. Dom(B_n^2) (Theorem A_n), and AB is bounded (Tanimoto)
nodes.G: Proven: the sum chi_n(xi) + chi'_n(eta) is self-adjoint on the intersection of their domains for every n, so (HA-T) holds for the Bullough-Dodd S-matrix at B = 1/2
nodes.F1: Try Kato-Rellich: show chi'_n(eta) is relatively bounded by chi_n(xi) with relative bound less than 1
nodes.F2: Take the KLMN form sum of the two positive operators chi_n(xi) and chi'_n(eta)
nodes.F3: Truncate one side: replace B_n^2 by the bounded operator min(B_n^2, M), so Z_A + Z_{B,M} is self-adjoint by bounded perturbation
nodes.F4: Check whether chi_n(xi) and chi'_n(eta) strongly commute, so their sum is self-adjoint by joint spectral calculus
nodes.F5: Apply Nelson's commutator theorem with a comparison operator such as the n-particle number or dilation generator
nodes.B1: The sum T is a positive symmetric operator with Ran(T + 1) equal to all of H_n
nodes.B2: For every f in H_n there are u_M with (Z_A + Z_{B,M} + 1) u_M = f and bounds on ||Z_A u_M|| and ||Z_{B,M} u_M|| uniform in M
nodes.B3: The adjoint equation T* v = -v has only the solution v = 0
nodes.B4: The form sum of chi_n(xi) and chi'_n(eta) has operator domain equal to the intersection of their domains
nodes.F6: No relative bound exists: both are unbounded analytic shifts in opposite imaginary directions, so neither controls the other
nodes.F7: The form sum is a self-adjoint operator extending chi_n(xi) + chi'_n(eta) on the intersection domain
nodes.F8: Expand the cross term <Z_A u, Z_{B,M} u> over cosets of S_n: B acting on slots 2 to n commutes with A_1^2, giving a non-negative contribution
nodes.F9: Bound the same-slot cross term by c ||A_1 u|| ||min(B_n, sqrt M) u|| using that AB is bounded
nodes.F10: They do not commute: the S-symmetrisation P_n couples slot 1 to slot n
nodes.B5: A positive symmetric operator T with Ran(T + 1) = H is self-adjoint
nodes.B6: Pass to weak limits as M goes to infinity: u_M converges to u in the domain with (T + 1) u = f
nodes.B7: 2 Re <Z_A u, Z_{B,M} u> is bounded below by -eps ||Z_A u||^2 - C ||u||^2, uniformly in M
nodes.B8: Show the form sum's operator domain equals Dom chi_n(xi) intersected with Dom chi'_n(eta)
